parameters.name: ContactGroups
parameters.description:
The alert contact group. The alert notifications of the application group are sent to the alert contacts that belong to the alert contact group.

>  An alert contact group can contain one or more alert contacts. For information about how to create alert contacts and alert contact groups, see [PutContact](~~PutContact~~) and [PutContactGroup](~~PutContactGroup~~).

parameters.name: GroupName
parameters.description: The name of the application group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms create-monitor-group --group-name ECS_Group --contact-groups ECS_Alert_Group --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms CreateMonitorGroup --region cn-hangzhou --GroupName ECS_Group --ContactGroups ECS_Alert_Group
